delivery._note: sourceQuality: 'official' = read on the platform's own help/blog page; 'secondary' = third-party article or search summary, not confirmed on the platform's page. Platforms set fees per order at checkout; where no published figure was found the field is null.

apps.name: DoorDash

deliveryFee.text: A fixed fee per order that varies by merchant.

serviceFeePct.text: In regulated markets: 15% of your subtotal for most orders (5% for most eligible DashPass restaurant orders). In other markets a variable fee that varies with distance and order size.

smallOrderFee.text: A fee may be charged if your order subtotal is below a certain amount. Third-party guides report about $2-$2.50 under about $10; not confirmed on DoorDash's page.

otherFees: Long Distance Fee for longer-distance orders

typicalDeliveryMinutes.note: Third-party timing studies disagree (one 2025 comparison: DoorDash ~26 min; a 2026 one: ~38 min). Not an official figure.

menuMarkup.note: DoorDash's fee article does not address menu markup; restaurants set their own app prices.

US.deliveryNote: Emily Post: 10-15% of the bill, or $2-5 for pizza delivery. NYC since 26 Jan 2026: apps must offer a tip of at least 10% at or before checkout.
US.legal: Tips are customary, not legally required; NYC delivery workers have a $22.13/h minimum before tips.

CA.trend: Angus Reid (Feb 2023): 21% of Canadians tipped 20%+ at their last restaurant meal vs 8% in 2016; 23% tipped under 15% vs 43% in 2016. POS prompts reach 30%.
CA.legal: Ontario ESA: tips may not be withheld or deducted except for statutory withholdings.

UK.basis: Often added to the bill as a discretionary service charge (12.5% is common in London); if added, no further tip is expected.
UK.deliveryNote: No authoritative norm found; Uber Eats/Deliveroo allow optional in-app tips.
UK.legal: Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023, in force 1 Oct 2024: tips, gratuities and service charges must be passed to workers in full and allocated fairly; a discretionary service charge can be removed at the customer's request.

IE.basis: Bill; groups (often 6+) frequently get a 10-12.5% service charge added, in which case no extra tip is expected.
IE.legal: Payment of Wages (Amendment) (Tips and Gratuities) Act 2022, from 1 Dec 2022: electronic tips and any 'service charge' must go to staff, cannot make up basic wages, and the distribution policy must be displayed.

MX.basis: Bill total; 10% is the customary minimum.
MX.deliveryNote: Rappi: tips are 100% voluntary and passed in full to couriers.
MX.legal: Profeco: a tip (propina) is voluntary; a business cannot add it to the bill without consent and may be fined for forcing it.
